contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' (1650.84) on the p4 Summary Page, which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page $1650.84' AND its printed 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report) $ 1650.84' — three statements of the same figure, all 40.00 above the rows
contributions.detail: TRACED, NOT ASSERTED, AND NOTHING NUDGED. The 8 written Schedule A rows sum to 485.05 + 50 + 50 + 25 + 100 + 25 + 50 + 825.79 = 1,610.84, exactly 40.00 BELOW the printed page subtotal of 1,650.84 (which the schedule's second footer, Box B, Box C and Box F all repeat). What was done before calling it a delta, in order: (1) THE ADDENDUM H3 DOUBLED-BAND SCREEN — every band was cropped individually at 900 dpi and each holds exactly ONE figure, so no entry is collapsed into a neighbour; (2) THE ONE-PAST-THE-END CONTROL — band 9 renders a WHOLLY EMPTY ruled cell, and bands 9-15 are unmarked on the full-page read; (3) THE ADDENDUM F1 TRAP-5 SCREEN — a crop of the strip BELOW the last printed grid rule renders only the printed 'Subtotal for this page $1650.84' line and its underline, with no entry written in the white space, so the ledger does not continue past the grid; (4) ALL EIGHT AMOUNT CELLS ESCALATED to tight 900 dpi crops and every one reproduced its 200 dpi reading exactly on clean machine type (485.05 / 50 / 50 / 25 / 100 / 25 / 50 / 825.79) — no single cell can absorb 40.00 without contradicting its own render, and every candidate substitution that would (50 to 90, 25 to 65, 100 to 140) is refuted at resolution; (5) THE CORRELATED-ERROR SCREEN returns NOT-CORRELATED-BY-ABSENCE — index.csv retains exactly one Taylor Fox filing, so there is no sibling report in which to look for the same 40.00 (the weber signature this screen exists to catch). CONCLUSION: the shortfall is not a misread and not a missed row; the filer's own printed total exceeds what he itemized by 40.00 — either his footer arithmetic or an unitemized 40.00 receipt. That cannot be attributed to any particular row FROM THE ROW'S OWN PAGE, so per the C5 discipline NOTHING WAS CHANGED, the delta is retained verbatim, and every row on the side carries needs_review=1. NOTE the shape of the whole document: the single figure 1,650.84 is printed EIGHT times (both Schedule A footers, both Schedule B footers, and Boxes B, C, D, E, F) while the two schedules' rows sum to two DIFFERENT amounts, 1,610.84 and 1,650.57 — so at most one side's rows could ever have matched it, and the figure is evidently not derived from either row set.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' (1650.84) on the p4 Summary Page, which is also Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page $1650.84' AND its printed 'Total Expenditures Made (Sum of all Schedule B pages in this report) $1650.84' — 0.27 above the rows
expenditures.detail: TRACED, NOT ASSERTED, AND NOTHING NUDGED. The 6 written Schedule B rows sum to 901.50 + 100 + 271.96 + 28.53 + 28.58 + 320 = 1,650.57, exactly 0.27 BELOW the printed page subtotal of 1,650.84 (repeated by the sum-of-all-pages total and by Boxes D and E). The same five screens were run as on the contribution side: every band cropped individually (one figure each, no doubled band); the one-past-the-end control at band 7 renders a WHOLLY EMPTY ruled cell; the strip below the last printed grid rule renders only the printed subtotal line, ruling out a row written past the grid; ALL SIX AMOUNT CELLS escalated to tight 1200 dpi crops and every one reproduced exactly on clean machine type (901.50 / 100 / 271.96 / 28.53 / 28.58 / 320), so the two cells that could each have absorbed 0.27 by a single-digit change (28.53 to 28.80, 28.58 to 28.85) are BOTH refuted at resolution; and the correlated-error screen returns not-correlated-by-absence, this filer having only one retained filing. The delta is therefore a fact about the document — the filer's printed total exceeds what he itemized by 0.27 — it is NOT uniquely attributable to any row from that row's own page, nothing was changed, and every row on the side carries needs_review=1.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only — and the two conventions are identical here, so neither explains either delta. Schedule A prints FOUR columns (Date / Name of Contributor / City and Zip Code / Amount) with NO in-kind checkbox column; no row on either schedule is annotated in-kind; the Summary Page carries no in-kind line and no compound '+Inkind' cell. BOTH conventions were tested on BOTH sides: monetary-only gives 1,610.84 and 1,650.57, monetary-plus-in-kind gives the same figures because there is no in-kind row to add, and neither reaches the stated 1,650.84 on either side.
itemized.escalation_note: Nineteen crops, all named with this filing's key — the most value-directed escalation in this chunk, because BOTH sides carry a delta and each had to be excluded as a misread before it could be retained. ALL FOURTEEN amount cells were cropped tight (p2's eight at 900 dpi, p3's six at 1200 dpi) and every one reproduced its full-page reading exactly on clean machine type; not one value was corrected. Both one-past-the-end controls rendered WHOLLY EMPTY ruled cells (p2 band 9, p3 band 7). Both below-the-grid strips were cropped at 700 dpi and rendered only the printed 'Subtotal for this page $1650.84' line and its underline over empty final grid rows — the ADDENDUM F1 trap-5 screen, negative on both pages. A MEASUREMENT NOTE: rowbands.py's vertical-rule output is unusable on both schedule pages of this filing (p2 returns 13.7 / 17.2 / 18.2 / 20.6, all margin artifacts; p3 returns a single 7.6) because the pages are photographs with a dark curved right edge, so the column bands were measured off the render; and on p3 its data_bands proposal MISSES THE GRID'S TOP RULE, opening at 20.52 which is row 2 — a transcriber who trusted it would have mis-indexed every row on that page by one and, because the amounts still sum the same, no arithmetic gate would have seen it.

itemized.notes: FORM CHARACTERISATION (2026 stock, eleventh and last specimen in this chunk) — variant modern_boxAF, footer 'v. 12.23' on every page, masthead 'Aaron Davidson, Clerk'. Four pages, summary LAST, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover, p2 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received', p3 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made', p4 'Summary Page'. NO CHECKLIST DECOY is bound in this document. Schedule A's third column is headed 'City and Zip Code'; Schedule B keeps the real Purpose column and the filer used it on every row; both are boxed 15-row grids printing their own two footers; the Summary Page prints A, B/C, D/E, F and an UNLETTERED close box. Report type '30 Days after withdrawal or elimination' is ticked, the amendment question is ticked 'No', the report is dated 5/15/26 throughout, foliation is continuous counting the cover (Pages 1-4). BORN-DIGITAL typed fillable form throughout except the Office cell, where 'County Commissioner' is typed and 'Seat A' is added BY HAND beside it; the whole document was then printed and PHOTOGRAPHED (each page is a different oversized mediabox with a dark curved shadow down the right edge), so row confidence stays at the OCR tier 'medium' per SCHEMA §6. *** THE FILING'S DEFINING PROPERTY: BOTH SIDES CARRY A RETAINED DELTA, AND THE SINGLE FIGURE 1,650.84 IS PRINTED EIGHT TIMES. *** It appears as both Schedule A footers, both Schedule B footers, and Boxes B, C, D, E and F — while the two schedules' rows sum to two DIFFERENT amounts, 1,610.84 (contributions, 40.00 short) and 1,650.57 (expenditures, 0.27 short). At most one side could ever have matched it, so the figure is evidently not derived from either row set. Both deltas were traced through the full screen set before being retained — doubled-band, one-past-the-end, below-the-grid, cell-by-cell escalation of all fourteen amounts, and the correlated-error screen — and NOTHING WAS NUDGED on either side. Every row on the filing carries needs_review=1 in consequence, and both sides are honest FLOORS relative to what the filer states. TWO DONOR ADDRESS CELLS HOLD A BARE DASH (rows 4 and 6, Daniel Hoffman and Stephen Anderson) — the filer's own explicit nil mark, distinct from an untouched cell and from a redaction, and the second instance of that cause in this chunk after Richard Smith's filing (1f938b1a). PAGE-FACE IDENTITY: cover, affirmation line and every sheet's candidate box read 'Taylor Fox', matching index.csv. The OFFICE BOX reads 'County Commissioner' with a handwritten 'Seat A', corroborating index.csv's 'County Commission Seat A' from the page itself. REDACTION: the county blacked out ONLY the cover's signature block — the candidate's full home street address, phone number and email are published in the clear, and neither schedule nor the summary carries any redaction. Nothing from that row is carried into this record, and every blank donor cell on p2 is blank because THE FILER MARKED IT NIL OR LEFT IT SO, never because anything was removed.
